fit_and_clock_rule: Use the frozen base study 29 training days, purge December 12 target and evaluate December 13-31, at first evaluation t-2 15:00 cutoff. All coefficients/scales use paired training only. Industry controls and original three financial features remain. No penalty, truncation, tuning or post-evaluation feature selection.
forecast_rule: Signed cashflow/profit ratios are retained. Raw negative absolute-return predictions are counted without clipping. Static operating data is not combined with company fixed effects; fixed-effect market model remains a reference.
limitations: The 2019 dates and retrospective January 2020 Q&A-selected cohort were already inspected. This is development, not new blind validation.
Source/PDF and market adjustment bytes were retrieved later and are not certified unchanged historical snapshots; own publication-date proxies are maintained.
Cash equivalents and trading assets are not unrestricted cash. The asset block has large source-based missingness and represents a different smaller issuer mix.
Ratios are YTD flows to period-end stocks or source revenue, not annualized ROA; coarse category controls omit business geography and detailed industry.
Repeated financial values and shared market dates are dependent. Delete-one-date ranges are sensitivity, not confidence intervals or p-values.
No stock direction, policy causality, real investor calibration or endogenous market-price improvement follows from a risk regression.
multiple_comparison_rule: Primary specified before computing outputs. Two secondary blocks exploratory; all results, rank/condition and delete-one-date sensitivity retained. No best block adopted as a signal.
pairing_rule: Every model including references is rebuilt on identical source-visible company-dates within the block. Asset block excludes all records lacking any fixed asset numerator; blanks and absent rows are not zero. Compare gains only within each block, not across different samples.
